newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH BOND YIELDS TICK DOWN ON U.S. PAYROLLS.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH BOND YIELDS TICK DOWN ON U.S. PAYROLLS.

text.p: Finnish bond yields fell as U.S. treasuries rallied after a weaker-than-expected rise in U.S. payrolls, but trading was calm, dealers said.
The 2006 benchmark bond ticked to 5.92 percent from 5.94 before the U.S. report and from 5.95 percent at Wednesday's close, tracking the reaction in Bunds.
"Germany did not react as strongly as the U.S.," one dealer noted. The German 10-year bond yielded 5.62 percent compared to 5.64 percent earlier.
U.S. June non-farm payrolls rose 217,000, slightly below a 222,000 average forecast.
